book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu Iye Sabat hana Guyau
Saugeine yake, he Sabat yanine hotiya Yeisu i setukan he wit hana baguye hotiya gamwane. Wana topadavae-yan si buwota, bwen si kibo wit hinone ge si han.
Sauge Farisi si paidiid, habeto si liwo Yeisu heine si nga, “U paidi, lam topadavae-yan si lake Sabat hana logugui.”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Age taine habe hu depahone Deivid lihuine, mwatan i ginawi pagan saugeine he-bwaineid wana bobode si buwota?

Deivid i la i setuk Helak he wana guwole, iloke bred gabgabubine gane si hotei Helak he hana hao, topowo i howo i giyau Deivid ge wana bobode heidiye ge si han. Bred yake si han, bwagane logugui i liwo tab si ehan, topowo ege si han.

Age taine habe hu edepahone Moses wana Logugui, gane i nga he yan Sabat hotiya ge hotiya topowo-yan si kaikaiwo he Guwole Gagabubine? Yan Sabat hana logugui hobak si lake ti yo, age taine wedi ngak i degan.
A liwo heimiu, tolomo hotiya mwage he ya, iye hidane i kai lake Guwole Gagabubine hidane.

Helak wana lihulihu hotiya hana sapu taine hu delapu, gane i nga, ‘Nau nuwau hatatilao pageine, tan nuwau man powopowoine.’ Akum lihulihu ga ya hana sapu hu lapu, bwen lo topadavae taine hu dehawa ngakngak-anid, sidiye taine wedi ngak i degan.
Kaiwane nau Tolomo Natune, nau Sabat hana Guyau.”
Yeisu I Papamolu he Sabat
Yeisu i dodogan hedi i lok i la i setuk hiyebe yake he wedi guwole tapwalolo.

Tolomo hotiya mwage te he yake, nimane panihebe hotiya i jalojalo. Farisi nuwadiye Yeisu hana pwapwatim si ginawi, iyete si tayak si nga, “Mwatan wada logugui i liwo pagan? Tab bosowaine tolomo ta pamolu he yan Sabat o taine?”
Habe i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hebe humiu hotiya, wana sip hotiya i gan ge yan Sabat i sopiyele he goi, bwele i bwangehasik ge i hotagan, ine?
Sip bigi lahine, agegene tolomo te bigi lahine suwok. Iyete Logugui i taeman ginawi dodohobine ta ginawi he yan Sabat.”
Habe i liwo tolomo yake heine i nga, “U parumwaru nimam.” Bwen nimane i parumwaru, ge hobak i dohob sohode hedi nimane panihebe.
Agegene Farisi si setagi, ge si la si nunuwotu mwatan si ginawi pagan iloke Yeisu si lopamate.
Yeisu Iye Helak wana Tokaiwo
Yeisu hobak i lapu Farisi wedi nuwotu bwen i seyok hiyebe yake. Bobode hoyowate si dumuyai hei ge wedi tobolebole-yan bwabwaligadiye i pamoluid,
age i topahadid tab si elihuyan bobode heidiye sega iye.
I ginawi sohode ti yake, iloke Helak wana lihulihu gane profet Aiseya i payoumate i tabwa tolosuwok, i nga:

content.text: Lo tokaiwo tagi ya, gane a hase,
ge iye lo logugui sapusapuine bwele i wasewase-yan bobode bwabwaligadiye heidiye.
Taine bwele i dehawagaisi ge i degon yaleyale,
ge taine halingane bwele i degopakai he hiyede.
Mwamwaho gane i kom taine bwele i demwanabebe,
suli gane i todau taine bwele i depabuwode.
Iye te sohode bobode henebwaden yayaluwadiye i pwayate taine bwele i deboleuid.
Bwele i kaiwo hana had nau Helak lo logugui sapusapuine i lake bigi bwabwaligane.
Iye hidane bobode hoyowate bwele si patamedan.

content: Farisi Si Liwo Tage Yeisu wana Gaisi I Luwom Seitan heine
Habeto bobode topadine si ho luwom tolomo hotiya, matane i gin ge taine i delihu, kaiwane yayaluwo bikbikine i solavi heine. Yeisu i pamolu habeto halingane i mapwe ge matane i palale.
Bwen bobode bwabwaligadiye nuwadiye si hape ge si nga, “Tab hebe iye Deivid Tubune?”
Agegene saugeine Farisi-yan si longe ti yake, habe si nga, “Yayaluwo bikbikine wedi todedei, Toberenunu, he wana gaisi te i epatile tagtaganid yayaluwo bikbikine.”

Yeisu i lapu ege wedi nuwotu, bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Hebe bagalogugui hotiya i ginawi boda ho-iwo ge totodiye si pelolomalekeid, bagalogugui yake bwele i mwao. O hebe hiyebe hotiya o hebe hun hotiya i ginawi boda ho-iwo ge totodiye si pelolomalekeid, bwele taine i degaisi.
Sohode hedi, hebe Seitan totone wana boda i patile taganid, iye te totodiye si pelolomalekeid, iloke wana bagalogugui bwele i mwao.

Hu nga tage Toberenunu he wana gaisi te a epatile tagtaganid yayaluwo bikbikine. Hebe hu liwo sohode ti yake, sega he wana gaisi ge humiu lemi topadavae-yan si epatile tagtaganid yayaluwo bikbikine? Totomiu lemi topadavae si payoumate lemi ngak.
Agegene hebe Helak Yayaluwane wana gaisi heine ge a epatile tagtaganid yayaluwo bikbikine, iye te Helak wana bagalogugui hobak i luwom heimiu.
“Taine bosowaine tolomo hotiya i desetuk tolomo gaigaisiine
he wana guwole ge wana gogomwau i deyomo, age? Hebe nuwane, dedei gen i yawan, habe wana guwole bigibigiine i yomo yogoyan.
“Sega taine i demiyemiye heyau, iye ho siviye. Sega hebe taine bwalu ha deyomo pasepase, iye tobibiyele.

A liwo heimiu, sega hebe i ginawi page ngakngakine ge hebe i gobwage ge i hawatautau-yan Helak, gegi ga yake bosowaine Helak i nuwoyok. Agegene sega hebe i gobwage ge i hawatautau-yan Yayaluwo Gagabubine, gegi ga yake Helak taine bwele i denuwoyok.

Sega hebe i gopanpangek-an Tolomo Natune, gegi ga yake bosowaine Helak i nuwoyok. Agegene sega hebe i gopanpangek-an Yayaluwo Gagabubine, gegi ga yake Helak taine bwele i denuwoyok, sauge ya o hebe sauge i eluwom.
“Hebe hubwahi dodohobine, iyete hinone i dohob. Hebe hubwahi ngakngakine, iyete hinone i ngak. Hebe ta paidi hinone bwen ta lapu hubwahi, hebe hubwahi dodohobine o hebe hubwahi ngakngakine.
Humiu Farisi sohode mwate! Humiu bobode ngakngakidiye, iyete tan bosowaine lihu dodohobine hu delihuyan. Taine suwok! Sahe hebe i susuwoku he hatiyede, iye te i setagi he hawade.
Tolomo gane dodohobine i puwoyan page dodohobine, sohode dohob gane i pase he hatiyene. Tolomo gane ngakngakine i puwoyan page ngakngakine, sohode ngak gane i pase he hatiyene.
“A liwo heimiu, he hasehase hana yan tolomo hotiya ge hotiya hana kot bwele i gan lihu ngakngakine hohoyowate kaiwane, gane i lihuyan.
Hebe halingamiu lihu dodohobine, Helak bwele i hawa dodohob-anmiu. Hebe halingamiu lihu ngakngakine, Helak bwele i hawa ngakngak-anmiu.”
Farisi Nunuwadiye Yeisu Pamali Yauyawate Hotiya I Ginawi Iloke Si Paidi
Habeto Farisi ge Logugui hana topapalapu topadine si liwo Yeisu heine si nga, “Topapalapu, nuwamai pamali yauyawate hotiya gen u ginawi ha paidi.”

Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Humiu sai yauyauleine, taine hu demiye Helak heine, bwen nunuwamiu bagapatuwohe hotiya a ginawi heimiu. Agegene taine bagapatuwohe hotiya a degiyau heimiu, iyege te gane i youmate profet Jona heine.
Sohode Jona i miyemiye he yalogi lahine tiniyene yan ho-tuwon ge gogou ho-tuwon, sohode hedi nau Tolomo Natune a miye he kelekele gamwane yan ho-tuwon ge gogou ho-tuwon.

He hasehase hana yan bobode Ninibe habe si suwomidi ge si hawa ngakngak-anmiu, kaiwane Jona wana papalapu si longe habeto si seyok wedi gegi. Tolomo hotiya mwage he ya, iye i kai lake Jona, age humiu wana papalapu taine hu delonge ge taine hu deseyok lemi gegi.

He hasehase hana yan ganahao Seba wedi kwin habe i suwomidi ge i hawa ngakngak-anmiu, kaiwane iye i luwom he ganahao bwagebwage nuwane i longe Solomon wana papatuwohe sibesibeine. Tolomo hotiya mwage he ya, iye i kai lake Solomon, age humiu taine hu delonge halingane.”
Yayaluwo Bikbikine I Setagiim Tolomo Hotiya hei ge I Sehavile hedi hei
“Sauge yayaluwo bikbikine i setagiim tolomo hotiya heine, bwen i la i sebayavin-an huyahai bwagebwageine wana bagamanao i luweni, age taine i depaidi hotiya.
Habeto i liwo i nga, ‘Gen a sehavile he habau gane a seyok.’ Saugeine i sehavile, i paidi bagamiye yake si yahi ge si bagavetahe, agegene guwole gamwane hohowane.

Bwen i yogo i la wana pan yayaluwo bikbikine wedi hohoyowate si he-pik (7) hedi i sehapeid, sidiye wedi page ngakngakine suwok, habe he-bwaineid si setuk ge si solavi he bagamiye yake. Bwen tolomo yake wana miyemiye dedei i ngak, age muyai ngakngakine suwok. Bwele i youmate sohode ti yo sai yauyauleine yan ya heidiye.”
Yeisu Tinane ge He-hauhauvane Nuwadiye Si Paidi
Yeisu mwage i lihulihu boda heidiye bwen tinane ge he-hauhauvane si sevin, si talmidi dedelawi, nunuwadiye bwaidiye si lihu.
Habe tolomo hotiya i giyau wana wase i nga, “Tinam ge he-hauhauvam mwage sidiye dedelawi si midimidi, nunuwadiye hene-bwaim gen hu lihu.”
Yeisu i golase halingane i nga, “Sega tinau, ge segawai he-hauhauvau?”
Habe nimane i sudilok wana topadavae heidiye ge i liwo i nga, “Tinau ge he-hauhavau sidiye tagi yeya!
Sega hebe i pabwasowo Tamau he bulubulu wana nuwotu, iye te havau, lu ge tinau.”

footnotes.text: Tolomo gaigaisiine, iye Seitan, ge tolomo gane i gaisi lake tolomo gaigaisiine iye Yeisu totone.
